rows.note: Use 和波 as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a contest result in which neither side wins.

example.english: The match ended in a draw.
example.jyutping: coeng4 bo1 tek3 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 hai6 wo4 bo1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically pulling something, including a body part or curtain.

example.jyutping: laai1 hoi1 zoeng1 lim4 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for producing a picture, line, or other representation with a drawing instrument.

example.english: I used a pencil to draw a cat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 jyun4 bat1 waa2 zo2 jat1 zek3 maau1

rows.note: Use this when something attracts attention or draws people toward it.

example.english: This new shop can draw lots of tourists here.
example.traditional: 呢間新店可以吸引好多遊客嚟。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 san1 dim3 ho2 ji5 kap1 jan5 hou2 do1 jau4 haak3 lai4

rows.note: Use this specifically when a game or match ends with neither side winning.

example.english: Last night’s match ended in a draw.
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 coeng4 bo1 daa2 wo4
